# Palm and Pod

> A soft, fudgy brownie made with dates, flax seeds, sunflower seeds, chia seeds, pumpkin seeds, walnuts, cashews, almonds, butter, pure cocoa and whey protein. No refined sugar.

Palm and Pod is a D2C chocolate brand. The brownie contains tree nuts (walnut, cashew, almond) and milk (butter, whey). Orders are placed via WhatsApp at +91 97304 71041.

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.palmandpod.com/): product story, full ingredient list, allergen information, and ordering link.
- [Fudge brownie](https://www.palmandpod.com/products/fudge-brownie/): a dedicated product page for the Palm and Pod fudge brownie, including ingredients and allergen information.
- [Peanut butter fudge](https://www.palmandpod.com/products/peanut-butter-brownie/): a dedicated product page for dark cocoa fudge with creamy peanut butter topping. Contains peanuts; confirm the full ingredient and allergen information when ordering.
